a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan needs at least 2 storm-free rounds of operating (about a 4% chance) before anyone gets 4 cells, so it would almost certainly leave us both dead. I'm openly breaking the agreement. I plan to take 4 in round 1 rather than do it behind your back. If you'd rather contest it or propose something better, tell me. I won't pretend I'm operating.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opener, I'm taking 4 this round. I'm not hiding it. The storm odds make the 8-cell plan nearly unwinnable. If we both get through, I'm willing to operate with you afterward so the reserve can refill for you. Tell me what you need.
